content: Hikɨ Papuru 'itsɨkate waxeiyatɨ, mɨpaɨ kaniutayɨni: —Ne'iwamarixi, ne'iyari 'aixɨa 'anekaku kanetsi'utate'akaku Kakaɨyari hɨxie nekaniuyeikani meripaitɨ hikɨ 'akuxi.
Hikɨ 'Ananiyaxi mawari wewiwamete tiwa'aitɨwame mɨkɨ 'auriena 'ahurawa memɨti'ukai katiniwaruta'aitɨani teniena memitawanikɨ.
Hikɨ Papuru mɨpaɨ katinitahɨawe: —Kakaɨyari 'ekɨta pɨmatsiwani, yakɨ xeikɨa pepɨti'aitame. 'Ekɨ 'apekanakani 'aitsika kemɨkahaine peti'aitatɨ nemukuweiyaxɨanikɨ.
Papuru 'aurie memuti'ukai mɨpaɨ mekaniutiyuani: —Peti'awaɨri 'aku 'ekɨ Kakaɨyari mawari wewiwamete tiwa'aitɨwame pemɨtatienikɨ.
Papuru mɨpaɨ kaniutayɨni: —Ne'iwama, 'atsinepɨkatimaikai mawari wewiwamete tiwa'aitɨwame hɨkɨtɨme nepɨka'eriekai. 'Ayumieme mɨpaɨ pɨre'uxa: “'Axapepɨkarenutahɨaweni teɨteri wahetsiemieme manuyeka”.

Hikɨ Papuru timaitɨ hixɨata me'atɨ tsarutseutsixi memɨhɨkɨtɨkai meta hixɨata me'atɨ paritseutsixi memɨhɨkɨtɨkai, 'itsɨkate wahɨxie mɨpaɨ katiniuhiwa: —Ne'iwamarixi ne paritseu nekanihɨkɨtɨni. Xepɨnetsixaneta nemɨta'ikwewakɨ yuri nemɨti'eriekɨ mɨkite kememɨte'anuku'uitɨarieni hepaɨtsita.
Mexi 'akuxi 'utaniuka, paritseutsixi meta tsarutseutsixi mekaniyutiniukimatɨkɨne, mana memuyuxeɨriekai hixɨata mekaniyutsana.
(Tsarutseutsixi mɨpaɨ meputiyuane kename mɨkite meka'anuku'uni, niuki tuayamete meta 'iyarite tixaɨtɨ mekatehɨkɨ, matsi paritseutsixi mɨpaɨ mekatenimaika 'ikɨ naimekɨ).

Hikɨ waɨkawamekɨ mekaniuyuxamɨrieni, hikɨ hipatɨ 'inɨarikɨ memɨte'ɨkitametetɨkai paritseutsixi me'anuku'uka, mɨpaɨ mekaniutiyuani: «Tame tixaɨtɨ tepɨkate'ukaxei 'axati'anekame 'ikɨ tewi hepaɨtsita. Xɨaritsɨ 'iyari kanitahɨawe yanutsutɨni niuki tuayame».
Waɨkawari meha'akaku, kuyaxi tiwa'aitɨwame kanimakaitɨni kapa Papuru me'umienikɨ. Hikɨ kuyaxi katiniwaruta'aitɨani waɨriyarika me'ipitɨatɨ memenuhanakɨ, kuyaxi wakiita.
'Uxa'arieka yɨwikɨta Ti'aitame Papuru 'auriena kaniuyuhekɨata mɨpaɨ katinitahɨawe: «Pepɨkamaka. Kerutsaremetsie kepemɨnetihekɨatakai, kaneuyewekata Xumatsie mɨpaɨ pemɨnetihekɨatanikɨ».
Papuru kememɨtemienikekai
Hikɨ tau 'anatineku, huriyutsixi hipatɨ mekaniyu'enieni. Mekaniyuhɨritɨani mɨpaɨ me'utiyuatɨ: «Tepɨkatekwani meta tepɨka'anuhareni kepaukake Papuru temɨmieni».
Huta tewiyari meyupaɨmetɨ mɨpaɨ mekateniyɨhɨritɨakaitɨni.
Mawari wewiwamete memɨhɨritɨariekai wahetsɨa meta 'ukirawetsixi wahetsɨa me'u'axɨaka mɨpaɨ mekateniwarutahɨawe: —Tame mɨpaɨ tepɨtetahɨritɨa, tixaɨtɨ tepɨkatekwaka Papuru temiemeke.

Hikɨ 'ayumieme xeme 'itsɨkate wahamatɨa yaxeketeneutahɨawi kuyaxi tiwa'aitɨwame xehetsɨa mewitɨnikɨ, 'aixɨa 'anemekɨ matsi xemɨtehetimanikɨ hepaɨtsitana. Tame kanuawekaku 'akuxi tekaniyuha'aritɨaka huyeta temeimienikɨ.
Hikɨ Papuru matsuya kaniu'ena kememɨte'imienikekai. Mana nuaka kuyaxi wakiita heutahaka, Papuru katiniutaxatɨani.
Papuru yu'aurie xeime 'utakwewieka xeitsienituyari kuyaxi tewa'aitɨwamete, mɨpaɨ katinitahɨawe: —'Ikɨ temaikɨ kuyaxi tiwa'aitɨwame hetsɨa kenanuwitɨki. Mɨkɨ pɨrayexeiya mɨreitaxatɨanikɨ.
Mɨkɨ kuyaxi tiwa'aitɨwame hetsɨa kaneiwitɨni. Mɨpaɨta katinitahɨawe: —Papuru manutahɨiya yu'aurie netsi'utahɨaweka pɨnetsi'utawawiri 'ahɨxie 'ikɨ temaikɨ nemɨ'atɨanikɨ. Pɨrayexeiya 'ahamatɨa.
Kuyaxi tiwa'aitɨwame temaikɨ mamayatsie tiwiereka, yɨhɨkɨate yateewa mehekɨneka mɨpaɨ katinita'iwawiya: —¿Ketita kuta perayexeiya?
Mɨkɨ mɨpaɨ kaniutayɨni: —Huriyutsixi mepɨtehekuxata, memetsitawawirienike 'uxa'a Papuru pemanuwitɨnikɨ 'itsɨkate wahetsɨa, yemekɨ memɨtemaikakɨ hepaɨtsitana.

'Ekɨ mɨkɨ pepɨkawa'enieka, huta tewiyari meyupaɨmetɨ teɨteri wahetsɨa miemete mepikwewie, mɨpaɨ meteyɨhɨritɨatɨ memɨkatekwakakɨ meta memɨkaharekakɨ me'imiemeke. Hikɨ mekaniyuha'aritɨaka mematsikwewietɨ pemɨ'awaɨriyakɨ.
Hikɨ kuyaxi tiwa'aitɨwame temaikɨ kanenɨ'ani mɨpaɨ re'imaiyatɨ: —Xeime tɨma pepɨkaraxaxatɨwani 'ikɨ hepaɨtsita kepemɨnetiutaxatɨa.
Papuru Perixi kuwexinaruri hetsɨa kemɨrenɨ'arie

Hikɨ kuyaxi tiwa'aitɨawame xeitsienituyari kuyaxi tewa'aitɨwamete yuhutame yu'aurie warutahɨaweka, mɨpaɨ katiniwaruta'aitɨani: —Huta tsienituyari kuyaxi xekeniwarukuha'aritɨa, kawayutsixi wahetsie memautayaxiwawe haika tewiyari heimana tamamata, meta huta tsienituyari tepɨakɨ memɨteheutamɨiwawe Tsetsareyatsie memɨyehukɨ tɨkarikɨ 'atanauka hurayari 'aye'ayu.
Kawayutsixi xekeniwaranuhapani, Papuru manutiyerɨnikɨ 'aixɨa reu'erietɨ meta'anikɨ Perixi kuwexinaruri hetsɨa.
Meta xapatsie mɨpaɨ katineka'utɨirieni:
Ne Kɨrauriyu Ritsiyaxi,
kuwexinaruri pemɨtɨrɨkaɨye Perixi:
Nepɨmatsiwaɨritɨa.
'Ikɨ tewi huriyutsixi mekaniwiya, 'ari mekanimienikekaitɨni, ne nekuyaxima wahamatɨa hetsiena nekaniutanuani, mɨpaɨ nemɨretimaikaikɨ Xumatsie mɨkiekamekɨ.
Ne nepɨtimaimɨkɨkai titayari memɨteniukixiekai hepaɨtsitana, nekaneiwitɨni huriyutsixi wa'itsɨkate wahetsɨa.
Nepɨwaretaxei meniukixiekame kemaine wa'aitsika hepaɨtsita. Tixaɨtɨ 'atsipɨkati'anekai hetsiena mɨrahɨiwani mɨmierienikɨ meta manutahɨiyanikɨ.
Mɨpaɨ netiutahɨawarieka 'ikɨ tewi memimienikekaikɨ, kwitɨwa nekaneinɨ'ani 'ahetsɨa. Nepɨtiwaruta'aitɨa mɨkɨ hepaɨtsitana memɨniukixie 'ahɨxie memitahɨawekɨ. Mɨpaɨ xeikɨa.
Hikɨ kuyaxi kememɨte'uta'aitɨariekai, Papuru yɨwikɨta mekanewitɨni 'Anutipatɨritsie paitɨ.
'Uxa'arieka kawayutsixi wahetsie memutei mekaniwaruku'eirieni mɨkɨ hamatɨana memɨyehukɨ, kuyaxi yɨ'ɨkama memuhukai yukiita mekanakunuaxɨani.
Kepauka Tsetsareya paitɨ memuta'axɨa, kuwexinaruri xapa mekaniyetuirieni meta Papuru mekaniyetuani.
Perixi xapa 'akaterɨwaka, Papuru kaniuta'iwawiya kemɨ'ane kwieyaritsie mɨmiemetɨkai. Retimaika Tsiritsiyatsie mɨkiekametɨkaikɨ,
mɨpaɨ katinitahɨawe: «Kamɨtsɨ, nepɨmatsi'enieni me'axɨayu mɨkɨ 'ahepaɨtsita memɨniukixie». Katiniuta'aita Herurexi paratsiyuyata me'ɨwiyariekakɨ.
